[[Eurocup Basketball|Eurocup]] | team = Herbalife Gran Canaria | number = 14 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1995|12|20}} | birth_place = [[Riga]], Latvia | highschool = | college = | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = 2012 | career_end = | years1 = 2012–2015 | team1 = [[BK VEF Rīga|VEF Rīga]] | years2 = 2015–present | team2 = [[CB Gran Canaria|Gran Canaria]] | years3 = 2015–2016 | team3 = →[[CB Gran Canaria B|Gran Canaria B]] | highlights = * 3x [[Latvian Basketball League|LBL]] champion (2012, 2013, 2015) * [[Supercopa de España de Baloncesto|Spanish Supercup]] champion (2016) * [[ACB Best Young Player Award|Spanish League All-Young Players Team]] ([[2016–17 ACB season|2017]]) }} '''Anžejs Pasečņiks''' (born December 20, 1995) is a Latvian professional [[basketball]] player. He currently plays for [[CB Gran Canaria|Herbalife Gran Canaria]] in the [[Liga ACB]]. ==Professional career== He made his professional debut in the Latvian League with [[BK VEF Rīga|VEF Rīga]] in 2012.http://www.euroleague.net/competition/players/showplayer?gamecode=2&pcode=003921 In August 2015, Pasečņiks signed with the Spanish club [[CB Gran Canaria|Herbalife Gran Canaria]]. He would play in its reserve team, club of the [[Liga EBA]], fourth division.{{cite web|url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=115222|title=Anzejs Pasecniks jugará en liga EBA con el Gran Canaria|date=13 August 2015|language=Spanish}} He debuted with the [[Liga ACB|ACB]] team in the [[2015 Supercopa de España de Baloncesto|Supercopa Endesa]]. ==Latvian national team== He is a regular Latvian youth national team player. He helped [[Latvia men's national under-18 basketball team|Latvia's U-18 national team]] reach semi-finals at the [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], where he was named to the All-Tournament Team, averaging 12.6 point and 7.7 rebounds at the tournament. ==Accomplishments and awards== ===Individual=== * [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship#Awards|2013 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]: All-Tournament Team * European Under-18 All-Star Game [[Most Valuable Player|MVP]] (2013) ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Anzejs_Pasecniks/Latvia/VEF_Riga/207237?PlayerID=207237 Anžejs Pasečņiks] at eurobasket.com * [http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Andzejs-Pasecniks-65023/ Anžejs Pasečņiks] at DraftExpress.com * [http://www.fibaeurope.com/cid_KNce8jInH7Qj1EsyH5rjn2.playerID_92765.compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2013.roundID_9420.teamID_2134.html Anžejs Pasečņiks] at FIBAEurope.com * [http://www.eurohopes.com/player/1760/anzejs-pasecniks/ Anžejs Pasečņiks] at eurohopes.com * [http://www.acb.com/jugador.php?id=FQH Anžejs Pasečņiks] at ACB.com * [http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=003921 Anžejs Pasečņiks] at EurocupBasketball.com {{CB Gran Canaria current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Pasecniks, Anzejs}} [[Category:1995 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:BK VEF Rīga players]] [[Category:CB Gran Canaria players]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:Latvian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Latvian expatriates in Spain]] [[Category:Expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:Liga ACB players]] [[Category:Power forwards (basketball)]]
